scenario_or_breakage: The plan says absent flags are DEFECT kind=unknown-flag, later says flag-not-in-help should be a graceful skip, while the acceptance test requires --context-files to defect. Implementing the skip rule would silently miss the primary regression.
suggested_fix: Make absent long flags a defect by default; reserve SKIPPED_FLAG_CHECK for unavailable help only, or require an explicit documented allowlist for known-terse helpers.

what: Parser/filter misses common repo-script invocation forms
scenario_or_breakage: Plans and skill snippets commonly call scripts through bash, sh, quoted ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/foo.sh, or absolute checkout paths; the proposed first non-flag token plus literal scripts/ filter drops those rows as system commands.
suggested_fix: Normalize interpreter wrappers and repo-root prefixes before filtering; cover bash scripts/foo.sh, sh skills/x/scripts/foo.sh, quoted ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/..., and absolute repo paths in parser tests.

what: No explicit source selector for Step 5c validation
scenario_or_breakage: validate-plan.sh is said to read plan.txt or composed-plan.md when invoked from Step 5c, but no CLI/action ARGS contract tells the wrapper which file to validate. A default-to-plan.txt implementation would let composed-plan-only command defects reach GitHub.
suggested_fix: Add a required wrapper flag such as --source plan|composed or --plan-file FILE, pass it in both ACTION=VALIDATE_PLAN_COMMANDS invocations, and assert Step 5c validates composed-plan.md in test-design-driver.sh.

scenario_or_breakage: The dry-run tier composes and executes the literal TSV command, so shell metacharacters, redirections, globbing, or expansions in plan text can run during validation when a script is later opted into the registry.
suggested_fix: Run dry-runnable scripts via an argv array from parsed tokens, reject or skip rows containing shell metacharacters/redirections/expansions, and execute in a temp cwd with tests proving injected separators and redirections do not fire.
